Winter Sports
at IBW.

The Ida B. Wells Winter Sports Club takes Guardians to Mt. Hood Meadows for nine Thursday nights in January and February — both teams ride the same night: Recreational to ride for fun, Competitive with coaching toward three competitions. Welcome

One club, two teams, same Thursday night.

Every rider picks one of two teams — both ski and snowboard, both ride at Mt. Hood Meadows on Thursdays, and both include the bus, chaperones, food on the way up, snacks on the way back, and OISA insurance. Recreational free rides and progresses at your own pace. Competitive adds coaching focused on preparing for competition, and its riders take part in three competitions during the season.

We are committed to providing a safe and inclusive space — welcoming students of every race, ethnicity, gender identity, income level, and ability. We provide scholarships for team memberships, passes, and gear to ensure every student can ski and snowboard regardless of financial constraints.

Compare the two teams ↓

Programs

Two teams. One Thursday night.

The club runs exactly two programs — Recreational and Competitive — and each one takes both skiers and snowboarders. Both ride on Thursdays this year; the difference is coaching and competition, not the night. Here’s the real split, in one place, instead of hunting through PDFs.

Recreational Team

Free ride, make new friends, and progress at your own speed. There’s no formal coaching — peer mentor coaches and adult coaches are there to help whenever you ask. This is also the natural home for first-timers: no races, no pressure, just Thursday nights on snow.

Thursdays · Ski & snowboard · No formal coaching

Competitive Teams — Ski & Snowboard

Coached teams on the same Thursday bus as Recreational. Coaching is focused on preparing riders for competition, and every Competitive rider takes part in three competitions during the season. Snowboarders compete in Banked Slalom, Boardercross, Slopestyle, and Half-Pipe — new riders start with Banked Slalom, a timed, solo, self-paced race that needs no advanced skills.

Thursdays · Coached · 3 competitions
Both teams include:Bus from IBW (2pm) & back (11pm)ChaperonesFood & drinks up · snacks backOISA insurance9 Thursday nights in Jan & Feb

First Time?

You don’t need to own a thing.

Most questions new families ask, answered on the page they land on — in plain sentences. The photo is the club’s own gear layout from its First Time page: this is the whole kit.

What do I need for the first day?

Warm waterproof layers, gloves, and a helmet. Skis / board, boots, and lift access can be arranged — ask about rental and scholarship help when you register.

I’ve never skied or snowboarded. Can I still join?

Yes — start on the Recreational Team. You free ride at your own pace on Thursday nights, and peer mentor coaches and adult coaches help whenever you ask. No racing required, ever.

Recreational or Competitive — how do I choose?

Both teams ride Thursdays, so you’re choosing a style, not a night. Recreational is ride-for-fun with no formal coaching and no competitions. Competitive adds coaching focused on preparing for competition, and riders take part in three competitions — beginners start with Banked Slalom, which is timed, solo, and self-paced. You can choose when you register.

How do lift tickets work?

Your Meadows pass or weeknight lift ticket is separate from club registration. The cost box above should link straight to the current Meadows options — that link belongs here, not buried in a paragraph.

What if cost is a barrier?

Scholarships cover membership, passes, and gear. Contact the club — asking is confidential and normal.

A question for the club

Would you be open to a little AI-agent help?

Not a new platform, and nobody’s data at risk. Think of it as a careful volunteer assistant that can check the site, test flows, and draft updates — while a human approves everything before it goes live. Here’s exactly what that looked like this week, so you can judge it on real work:

👁 Human approves first
Nothing publishes, sends, or changes without Winnie / Christia saying yes.
🔒 No student data, no payments
Read-only checks. It stops at login / email gates — exactly as it did at TeamSnap.
🛑 Easy to stop
One-off help or a weekly check — you choose the scope, and it stops any time.
